fields.PRODUCT NAME: Brass Rectangular Embossed Serving Tray (15 inches)
fields.DESCRIPTION: Serve with elegance and tradition using this exquisite Brass Rectangular Embossed Serving Tray. Handcrafted from high-quality brass, it features a beautifully embossed floral design at the centre and a finely detailed border, giving it a rich and regal look. Perfect for serving sweets, dry fruits, or beverages, this tray is also ideal for festive occasions, puja ceremonies, or as a decorative piece for your home. Its durable brass construction ensures long-lasting shine and timeless appeal.
